subject: Urgent: Verify Your Account to Avoid Suspension
body:
Dear Customer, 

We detected unusual activity on your PayPal account. Please verify your identity immediately by clicking the link below to avoid suspension:

http://paypall-secure.com/verify-login

Thank you,
PayPal Support Team
indicators: Sender email domain 'paypall-secure.com' is a lookalike domain, not the official paypal.com; Urgency and fear tactic used to prompt immediate action; Link directs to a non-official URL designed to harvest credentials; Generic greeting 'Dear Customer' instead of personalized user name

subject: Microsoft Account Password Expired
body:
Hello,

Your Microsoft account password has expired. Please reset your password within 24 hours to continue accessing your email and services:

https://microsoftsecurity-alert.com/reset-password

If you do not reset your password, your account will be locked.

Regards,
Microsoft Support
indicators: Sender domain 'microsoftsecurity-alert.com' is suspicious and not a legitimate Microsoft domain; Threat of account lockout to create urgency; Link URL is not a Microsoft official domain; Lack of personalized information or official branding

subject: Action Required: Confirm Your Bank Account Details
body:
Dear Valued Customer,

We have noticed suspicious login attempts on your bank account. Please confirm your account details by logging in through the link below:

http://secure-bank-login.com/confirm

This is to ensure your account safety.

Best Regards,
Your Bank Security Team
indicators: Sender domain 'secure-bank-login.com' is not an official bank domain; Suspicious login attempt claim to induce fear; Link leads to a fake website designed to harvest credentials; Generic salutation instead of personalized customer name
